capabilities: Reorder and nest blocks by drag-and-drop
Convert blocks between 18 types via menu or slash commands
extras: Desktop only. Rendering columns in Live Preview is an experimental setting; when off, columns fall back to native nested callouts.
problem: Obsidian lacks Notion-style block manipulation, making it hard to reorder, nest, convert, or recolor individual blocks without manual Markdown editing.

relations.evidence: A Notion-style block editor plugin for Obsidian

summary: Notion-style block editor that adds block handles, drag-and-drop reordering, multi-select, type conversion, columns, and block colors to Obsidian.
